usta-1011112.name: Walnut Sarı Burma
usta-1011112.description: A memorable traditional sweet with a golden colour, twisted shape and generous walnut filling.
usta-1011112.ingredients: wheat flour, sugar, clarified butter (dairy product), walnuts, water, eggs, wheat starch, table salt, lemon juice.
usta-1011112.allergenInfo:
Contains Gluten (wheat), eggs, dairy products (clarified butter) and tree nuts (walnuts).

May contain traces of pistachios because it is processed on the same production line.
usta-1011112.servingSuggestion:
For the best flavour, enjoy your product at room temperature.

You may also gently warm it in the oven before serving.
usta-1011112.storage:
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

For everyday consumption, we recommend avoiding refrigeration, as it may affect the consistency of the syrup.
usta-1011112.longTermStorage:
You can store your products in the freezer at -18 °C for up to 30 days.

For the best flavour, thaw at +4 °C for 2 hours, then allow to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving. Thawing directly at room temperature may cause dryness and a loss of crispness.

Do not refreeze thawed products.

usta-1010114.ingredients: wheat flour, sugar, clarified butter (dairy product), pistachios, water, eggs, wheat starch, table salt, lemon juice.
usta-1010114.allergenInfo:
Contains Gluten (wheat), eggs, dairy products (clarified butter, milk) and tree nuts (pistachios).

May contain traces of walnuts because it is processed on the same production line.
usta-1010114.servingSuggestion:
For the best flavour, enjoy your product at room temperature.

You may also gently warm it in the oven before serving.
usta-1010114.storage:
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

For everyday consumption, we recommend avoiding refrigeration, as it may affect the consistency of the syrup.
usta-1010114.longTermStorage:
You can store your products in the freezer at -18 °C for up to 30 days.

For the best flavour, thaw at +4 °C for 2 hours, then allow to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving. Thawing directly at room temperature may cause dryness and a loss of crispness.

Do not refreeze thawed products.
